entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: A famous shapeshifting Elder Dragon, killed by Tevesh Szat and later made into the Planar Barge.

entities.name: Piru
entities.description: Dragon, Chromium's life partner and cousin, killed by Dakkon with the Black Blade.

entities.name: Crosis
entities.description: Son of Chromium and Piru.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon, Chromium's brother, who instigated the Elder Dragon War.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Elder Dragon, Chromium's sister, kept asleep beneath Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: Dragon cousin who woke Palladia to lift a curse on him.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: Elder Dragon brother of Chromium, killed by Kristina.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: Planeswalker whom Chromium and Piru served.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: Planeswalker who fought Chromium and killed Piru.

entities.name: Ad'Amra
entities.description: Human warrior spellcaster who fell in love with 'Ham'.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: Planeswalker Chromium served who secretly betrayed the others.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Faralyn's spellsquire who turned Chromium into the Planar Barge.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Planeswalker who summoned Arcades Sabboth and plotted with Faralyn.

entities.name: Kristina
entities.description: Planeswalker who killed Arcades Sabboth and revived Ravidel.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Kristina's lover who helped revive Ravidel.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Planeswalker who killed Chromium.

entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: Person whose Backdraft damaged the Planar Barge.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: Spawned the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Planar Barge
entities.description: Interplanar flying ship fashioned from Chromium's corpse.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: War instigated by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Battle at Mors Ridge
entities.description: Rampage of Palladia and Vaevictis's army.

entities.name: Summit of the Null Moon
entities.description: Meeting called by Faralyn inside the Shard of the Twelve Worlds, a betrayal.

entities.name: Planeswalkers' War
entities.description: War led to by Ravidel's vengeance.

entities.name: Mors Ridge
entities.description: Place where Palladia slept.

entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: Shard in which Chromium was caught.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Plane the planeswalkers escaped to.

events.summary: Chromium is spawned by the Ur-Dragon and learns to shapeshift into human form.
events.quote: he taught himself to shapeshift into a human form

events.summary: Chromium hides among humans during the Elder Dragon War and survives.
events.quote: he was one of the few survivors of the War

events.summary: Dakkon fights Chromium and Piru for Dihada; Chromium drains Dakkon, who teleports him away and then kills Piru with the Black Blade.
events.quote: Dakkon was reunited with the Black Blade and used it to kill the dragon

events.summary: Vaevictis wakes Palladia, who rampages at Mors Ridge; Chromium and Ad'Amra put her back to sleep.
events.quote: managed to put the sleep-spell back on Palladia

events.summary: Chromium pledges to Faralyn and befriends Ravidel; Arcades Sabboth is killed by Kristina.
events.quote: Chromium once again pledged allegiance to a planeswalker

events.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon, Faralyn, Leshrac and Szat betray the others; Szat kills Chromium so they can escape to Shandalar.
events.quote: Szat killed Chromium, who was powerful enough to allow them to escape

events.summary: Ravidel is killed but revived by Kristina and Taysir, and plots vengeance.
Ravidel fashions Chromium's corpse into the Planar Barge.
events.quote: Ravidel took Chromium's corpse and fashioned it into what he called a Planar Barge
